prayerExcerpt.en-US: We may be strengthened in faith and constancy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Sejamos firmes na fé e na perseverança.

meta.face: A young noblewoman of eighteen with a fine oval face, fair olive skin, a straight classical nose, dark chestnut hair braided and coiled up beneath the crown with a few loose strands, large dark-brown eyes and a clear, intelligent, composed gaze.
meta.basis: The Golden Legend makes her a king's daughter, 'fair of visage', learned in the liberal arts, eighteen when she disputed in Alexandria, and says the wheels were broken at her prayer; crown, wheel, palm, book and sword are her standard attributes. The dark chestnut hair follows Caravaggio and keeps her apart from Agnes, Lucy and Philomena.
